exposure: medical treatment for cesarean scar pregnancy (local, systemic, and combined methotrexate)
surgical treatment for cesarean scar pregnancy (dilatation and evacuation, hysteroscopic resection, laparoscopic and laparotomic approaches)
cohort: Forty-eight patients diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy were included in the final analysis.
finding: Surgical intervention for cesarean scar pregnancy demonstrated significantly higher success rates (96.6%) and lower complication rates (3.3%) compared to medical treatment (33% success, 66% complications).
